The volcano below erupts in a fountain of fire and ash, the wheeling flock silhouetted against the glowing column.
Two dragons break from the flock to clash mid-air, jaws locked, tumbling through the swarm wreathed in fire.
A shaft of golden god-rays breaks through the cloud, lighting the wheeling swarm of dragons from the side.
A distant storm flickers with constant lightning, the silhouettes of the flock strobing against the violet-black wall.
A tiny castle far below bristles with panicked torchlight as the vast dragon-swarm passes overhead like a living storm.
A comet streaks across the sky above the flock, trailing cold blue fire against the wheeling mass of wings.
Several dragons breathe in unison, a great simultaneous flame-burst rolling through the flock like a wave of orange sun.
A vast murmuration of starlings scatters in every direction as the dragon-brood tears through their wheeling cloud like smoke.
A rival flock of dragons approaches on the horizon, dark and numerous, the two swarms banking toward each other.
The sun sets blood-red behind the flock, each dragon rimmed in copper fire, wings glowing like stained glass.
A second volcano answers the first across the valley, twin eruption columns framing the wheeling brood between walls of ash.
Three dragons peel off and dive at one another in a spiraling brawl, breaking back into the flock trailing smoke.
A beam of silver moonlight cuts through the overcast, catching the underside of a hundred wings in ghostly white.
A tiny medieval army halts on the road below, spears lowered, shields raised, staring upward in collective frozen terror.
A meteor shower opens above the flock, streaks of white fire crossing the sky as the dragons wheel beneath.
One enormous dragon at the swarm's center rears back and releases a sustained roar of flame, lighting the whole flock orange.
A flock of geese vanishes instantly, scattered into a white explosion of wings and honking chaos before the approaching brood.
The rival flock on the horizon has grown enormous now, its mass darkening the sky like an oncoming thunderhead.
The dying sun bleeds scarlet across every cloud, turning the entire sky to fire as the flock wheels through it.
Lightning walks across the distant peaks in slow, bright steps, each bolt briefly illuminating the silhouettes of the wheeling brood.
A walled city far below erupts in bells and signal fires, tiny figures streaming through gates as the shadow falls.
A rogue dragon at the swarm's edge attempts a breach, two others immediately intercepting it in a savage mid-air collision.
Curtains of golden god-rays fan wide across the sky, the dragon-swarm passing through them like fish moving through bright shafts of water.
A second comet follows the first, crossing it at an angle, the twin trails forming a burning X above the flock.
The great flame-burst from the swarm's heart sends a shockwave of heat haze rolling outward, distorting the dragons beyond it like a mirage.
